projects.intro_text: A selection of my academic and personal works, combining technical skills and creativity.
projects.project_allojn_description: Suite of 3 platforms (on-demand emergency home services, multi-vendor marketplace, staffing/recruitment), each featuring Client/Provider apps + Admin back-office. From Figma design to full Flutter frontend.
projects.project_tontine_crypto_description: Comprehensive Flutter frontend for a decentralized tontine app: embedded crypto wallet, smart contracts (Polygon/Base/Celo), on-chain payments, non-KYC mode, and biometric authentication.
projects.project_tor_embedded_description: Native Tor client embedded into 19 Android applications to secure communications via .onion addresses without third-party app dependencies (like Orbot). NDK, ProGuard/JNI & SOCKS5h.
projects.project_embedded_ai_description: Technical guide and integration of a lightweight Small Language Model running locally on mobile devices (GGUF format, llama.cpp engine, Vulkan hardware acceleration on Flutter).
projects.project_garage_management_description: Comprehensive automotive repair ERP on Odoo 19 & Docker. Custom module for vehicle & repair tracking, Kanban workflow, role-based security, automated billing, QWeb reports, and external Flask client portal (XML-RPC API).
projects.project_garage_management_feature_1: Custom models (vehicles, repair orders) with status workflow (Diagnostic → In Progress → Done → Invoiced)
projects.project_garage_management_feature_2: Interactive Kanban dashboard with drag-and-drop between statuses
projects.project_garage_management_feature_3: Role-based access control (mechanic vs manager) with record-level data filtering
projects.project_garage_management_feature_4: Business automation: automatic customer notification emails triggered on status update
projects.project_garage_management_feature_5: QWeb PDF report generation: vehicle exit voucher detailing parts and labor
projects.project_garage_management_feature_6: Real accounting integration: automatic generation of Odoo invoices (account.move)
projects.project_garage_management_feature_7: External customer portal built in Flask consuming Odoo API via XML-RPC without account required
projects.project_garage_management_feature_8: Fully containerized multi-container environment with Docker & Docker Compose (Odoo 19 + PostgreSQL 16)
projects.project_giftplan_description: Cross-platform mobile application for gift planning with collaborative lists, real-time contribution tracking, QR code sharing, and push notifications.
projects.project_agileflow_description: Development of a full-stack Agile project management application featuring real-time Kanban boards, JWT authentication, and automated PDF report generation.
projects.project_chrionline_description: Development of a native client-server application via TCP/UDP sockets featuring cart management, orders, simulated payment, JavaFX GUI, and defense against network attacks (Brute Force, SYN Flood, IP Spoofing, UDP Flood, Replay Attack, Session Hijacking, Command Injection).
projects.project_automate_description: C implementation of finite automata (DFA/NFA) with advanced operations: union, concatenation, Kleene star, determinization, and minimization.
projects.project_service_pro_description: Web platform like "Uber" for home services (plumbers, electricians). Availability management, bilateral rating, real-time chat, and geolocation.
projects.project_ecommerce_description: Marketplace for Moroccan cooperatives. OAuth authentication, AI Chatbot (Gemini), promo codes, PDF invoices, and a complete analytical dashboard.
projects.project_afcon_description: Dynamic website to follow the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations in Morocco. Match schedule, news, and interactive features.
projects.project_space_defender_description: 2D space arcade game developed in Java/Swing. Enemy wave system, score, bonuses, and fluid animations.
projects.project_gestion_foot_description: Football field reservation application. Management of schedules, clients, payments, and an administrator dashboard.
projects.project_hotel_docker_description: Containerized full-stack hotel reservation system. Micro-services architecture simulated with Docker for simplified deployment.
projects.project_pharmacy_description: Complete Desktop application for pharmacies. Stock management, expiry alerts, supplier orders, and sales statistics.
